games.name: [🤖] Build to Survive the Robots 2
games.desc:
[UPDATE]
- Added face cosmetics
- Added firmware robot upgrades
- Added Instant Defense map for Mount Infernus
- Reduced lag

Robots have taken over the world! Survive as a human, or join forces and hunt them down as a robot!

⚔️ How To Play ⚔️
1. Build a base before nightfall
2. Fight and survive the robots until the morning
3. Don’t die, or you will become a robot!

🎮 Controls 🎮
- Shift (LT on console): sprint/activate ability
- RMB (L3 on console): aim down sights
- G (D-Pad down on console): open shop
- Long click: auto-build/delete

💡 Tips 💡
• Purchase better items and upgrade their stats in the shop
• Build high, use strong materials, and layer blocks together for maximum protection
• Destroy all connected foundations of a base to knock it down as a robot
• Test different designs on sandbox servers, which features build saving & infinite blocks

Private servers include free admin commands! 🙂
